verdict.rationale: Runpod ships an agent-skills plugin and MCP servers explicitly designed so users can ask their AI agent in natural language to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy code, backed by a live hosted MCP server and API confirmed via runtime probes. This is a first-party, agent-native workflow rather than just CLI/API access repurposed for agents. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on confirmation that the natural-language agent-skills workflow works end-to-end as described.
